assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.title: Co-authoring spaces are conceptual operational interfaces
assumptions.description: Editing rooms, comment links, landmarks and scenario locations express relationships only and are not parcel, engineering, ownership or approval conclusions.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official boundary, existing conditions, ownership, regulatory controls, transport, heritage and utility data become available.
